title: Allow the configured Sentry ingest origin through the enforced browser policy

source.ref: Anonymous production browser audit CSP violation, 2026-10-23

detail:
Production browser reported Sentry envelope requests blocked by connect-src: the client SDK was configured but the enforced policy omitted its ingest origin. Derive the exact HTTPS origin from the same public/server DSN fallback as the SDK; include only that origin, without userinfo, project path or vendor wildcard. Malformed or non-HTTPS values add nothing. A real config.headers() regression failed before repair; focused telemetry, CSP and instrumentation batch passes 91 tests in seven suites, with a final 13-test CSP rerun after mock isolation. A standalone low-cost probe evaluates actual config declarations and the actual pure helper without loading the build plugin or spawning another runner. Existing Stripe hosts, object/base/frame restrictions and production eval exclusion remain tested. No synthetic event was sent to production Sentry; provider ingestion acceptance remains unproven until deployment and controlled validation. Official Sentry CSP guidance confirms the configured regional ingest endpoint is the required connection source.

2026-10-25 local integration against currentmain9b9c723e8: upstream independently adds the exact audited organization ingest origin and its own source controls. Preserve that canonical destination and the new canonical design resolver. Retire this audit's unreleased dynamic DSN helper and import to avoid duplicate/orphan transport logic; this is not a removal of shipped upstream functionality. Updated cheap probe and actual config.headers tests assert the canonical endpoint, reject unrelated or malformed DSN expansion/credentials/wildcards and retain object/base/frame/eval restrictions. The source-specific incoming guard remains unchanged. Font trace retirement remains intact in the same next.config merge; do not restore dead face paths from the incoming old font list. No telemetry send or deployed acceptance is inferred.

verify.note: Evaluate actual canonical policy and design resolver; retain only the audited transport destination and security restrictions, without a duplicate DSN helper.
